typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

ediVersion.description: the EDI document version of the properties set.

dtpTimeMapping.description: mappings on how to match date and time data entities.

newLoopSegments.description: set of segments that explicitly state a new loop has started.

loopTrailingSegments.description: set of segments that explicitly state a loop has ended.

dateTimePeriodNames.description: set of field names for the fields with DATE type.

documentMetadataTag.description: a name that object with document metadata should have

controlHeaderTag.description: a name that object with control data should have

documentStartTag.description: a name of a segment tag with a transaction set start

documentEndTag.description: a name of a segment tag with a transaction set end

beginningHierarchTransactionTag.description: a name of a segment tag with a hierarchical transaction set start

hierarchLevelTag.description: a name of a segment tag with a new hierarchial level start

defaultYyFormatPreffix.description: a preffix for the case the year in a date is represented in YY format not a YYYY

rd8DtpSeparator.description: a separator for the date in rd8, for example "-" is one for the "15111994-15112004" date.

currentHlTag.description: a name for a segment loop's key that states specific HL expected

customRule1Loop.description: loop name for a custom rule #1.

customRule1Segment1.description: first segment's name for a custom rule #1.

customRule1Segment2.description: second segment's name for a custom rule #1.

customRule1Segment3.description: third segment's name for a custom rule #1.

customRule1Segment4.description: fourth segment's name for a custom rule #1.

periodBoundariesNames.description: names for date period boundaries when period occurs.

name: X12ParserProperties
